one_liner: The OpenRouter for GPUs: one interface that aggregates and routes GPU capacity across providers.

roles.competitor: Sells the same job to the same buyer: one buying or routing surface over many GPU providers.
roles.supplier: Has GPU capacity Gridline could route to.
roles.partner: Complements Gridline: data, settlement, financing or metering it could plug into.
roles.adjacent: Builds market structure around the GPU-hour but doesn't sell compute access to Gridline's buyers.
roles.buyer: Would buy GPU capacity through Gridline.
